hero.headline: Immersive training, taught by working professionals
hero.subheadline: Complete courses you follow remotely, real-world practice, and human support at the centre in Tanger. You move at your own pace, and never on your own.

method.title: Our immersive method
method.subtitle: Four principles that make the difference between following a course and actually being able to do the job.

featured.title: Featured courses
featured.subtitle: A selection of our most requested courses, updated every month.

paths.title: Learning paths
paths.subtitle: Courses arranged in the right order, all the way to the certificate, at a bundle price.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.body: A few details are enough: name, email address and phone number. You then confirm your address.

step2.title: Your account is approved by our team
step2.body: We check your details and activate your account, usually within 24 business hours.

step3.title: Choose your course and send your receipt
step3.body: Pay by bank transfer or in cash at the centre, then upload your transfer receipt from your account area.

step4.title: Access granted, you start learning
step4.body: As soon as the payment is verified, the course opens: videos, resources, quizzes and progress tracking.

pricing.title: A fair price, no surprises
pricing.subtitle: Compare it with what an equivalent in-person course costs. Everything is included: resources, certificate, support and live sessions.

finalCta.title: Start your training today
finalCta.body: Create your account in two minutes. Our team approves it within 24 business hours and helps you choose the right course.

landing.title: The Centre de Formation Immersive platform is taking shape.
landing.tagline: The technical groundwork is in place: four languages, light and dark themes, a component library and the data model. The courses come next.
landing.showcaseHint: Tokens, components and states, in both themes and all four languages.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Your account is approved manually by our team, usually within 24 business hours.
register.lead: A few details are enough. You then confirm your email address, and our team approves your account.

hints.phone: We use it to reach you on WhatsApp about your account.
hints.password: At least 10 characters, with letters and digits.
hints.professionalStatus: Optional. It helps us point you to the right course.
hints.preferredLocale: The language of the interface and of our emails.

success.title: Your account has been created
success.body: We have sent a confirmation link to your email address. Open it to continue your registration.

verify.title: Confirm your email address

verify.resendIn: A new link can be sent in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
verify.resent: The confirmation link has been sent again.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: We have sent a confirmation link to {maskedEmail}. Open it to activate your registration.
verifyEmail.spamHint: Message not arriving? Check your spam folder before asking for a new one.

success.title: Your email address is confirmed
success.body: Thank you. Our team is now checking your details and approving your account.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Confirmation links stay valid for 24 hours. Ask for a new one to finish your registration.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.body: The link is incomplete or has already been used. Ask for a new one to confirm your address.

pending.title: Your account is being reviewed
pending.body: Thank you for registering. Our team is checking your details and approves every account manually, usually within 24 business hours. You will receive an email as soon as your account is activated.
pending.whatsappPrompt: Need to speed things up? Message us on WhatsApp.
pending.autoRefresh: This page updates by itself. There is nothing for you to do.

approved.title: Your account is approved
approved.body: Your training area is open. You can choose your first course.

rejected.title: Your registration could not be approved
rejected.body: Our team was unable to approve your account. The reason has been sent to you by email.

forgotPassword.title: Forgotten password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: If an account exists for {maskedEmail}, a reset link has just been sent. It stays valid for one hour.
sent.hint: Message not arriving? Check your spam folder, then try again in a few minutes.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Your new password must contain at least 10 characters, with letters and digits.
resetPassword.sessionsRevokedNotice: For security, all your open sessions will be closed, including on your other devices.

success.title: Your password has been changed
success.body: All your sessions have been closed. Log in with your new password.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Reset links stay valid for one hour and can only be used once. Ask for a new one.

rejected.title: Your registration could not be approved
rejected.body: After checking your details, our team was unable to approve your account.
rejected.whatsappPrompt: Do you think this is a mistake? Message us on WhatsApp and we will look at your file again.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: Access to your training area is suspended for the time being.
suspended.whatsappPrompt: To reactivate your account, message us on WhatsApp.

verifyEmail.body3: If you did not register with us, ignore this message: no account will be activated.
verifyEmail.footer: Sent by the Centre de formation immersive, in Tanger. A question? Message us on WhatsApp.

accountPending.subject: Your account is being reviewed

accountPending.body2: Our team is checking your details and approves every account manually, usually within 24 business hours. You will receive an email as soon as your account is activated.

accountApproved.body1: Your account is approved: your training area is now available.
accountApproved.step2: Choose the course that matches your goal.
accountApproved.step3: Send your transfer receipt: your access is activated as soon as it is verified.
accountApproved.footer: Sent by the Centre de formation immersive, in Tanger. A question? Message us on WhatsApp.

accountRejected.body3: You can correct the details concerned and register again. Our team remains available on WhatsApp.
accountRejected.footer: Sent by the Centre de formation immersive, in Tanger. A question? Message us on WhatsApp.

passwordReset.subject: Password reset

passwordReset.body1: You asked to reset the password of your account.
passwordReset.body2: Choose a new password using the link below. It stays valid for one hour and can only be used once.
passwordReset.body3: If you did not make this request, ignore this message: your current password remains valid.
passwordReset.footer: Sent by the Centre de formation immersive, in Tanger. A question? Message us on WhatsApp.

passwordChanged.preheader: A security confirmation for your account.

passwordChanged.footer: Sent by the Centre de formation immersive, in Tanger. A question? Message us on WhatsApp.
